description: This file contains extension methods for the PdfSharp testing helper namespace, including string splitting, assembly location retrieval, and sequence chunking (conditional compilation for .NET versions).

classes.name: TestHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for string manipulation, assembly location retrieval, and sequence chunking.

methods.name: Splitter
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of substrings based on a separator string.

methods.name: GetOriginalLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the original file path of an assembly, handling different .NET versions.

methods.name: Chunk
methods.description: Splits an IEnumerable into chunks of specified maximum size (conditional compilation for .NET versions below 6.0).
